2. By way of this petition, the Petitioner is praying for initiation of the contempt proceedings for non-compliance of the order dated 15.05.2019 passed by the Co-ordinate Bench of this Court in WPC No.1706 of 2019.

By virtue of the said order, following direction has been issued at paragraph 4, which reads as under :-
"4.
It is settled proposition that the person cannot be deprived of his property otherwise than in due course of law.
The course of law has been provided under the National Highway Act, 1956 for acquisition of land.

Since it is alleged that construction of road has already been made, the respondents are directed to demarcate the affected land of the petitioners and thereafter commence and conclude the proceedings of compensation within a period of 9 months from the date of presentation of copy of this order.
If it is found that the lands of the petitioners have been acquired without there being any compensation and the compensation is awarded, the same may be disbursed to the petitioners."

2. By way of this petition, the Petitioner is praying for initiation of the contempt proceedings for non-compliance of the order dated 15.05.2019 passed by the Co-ordinate Bench of this Court in WPC No.1706 of 2019.
It is settled proposition that the person cannot be deprived of his property otherwise than in due course of law.
Since it is alleged that construction of road has already been made, the respondents are directed to demarcate the affected land of the petitioners and thereafter commence and conclude the proceedings of compensation within a period of 9 months from the date of presentation of copy of this order.
If it is found that the lands of the petitioners have been acquired without there being any compensation and the compensation is awarded, the same may be disbursed to the petitioners."
It appears that being aggrieved with the aforesaid order, National Highway Authority has preferred an appeal, which was registered as WA No.192 of 2020 and after considering the same, the order as passed by the learned Single Judge, has been affirmed.
4. It appears further that in pursuance to the directions issued by this Court on 15.05.2019, affirmed in appeal by the Division Bench of this Court, a demarcation was carried out on 26.12.2022,
wherein, it was found that the Petitioner's land has not been affected for construction of the National Highway No.200/30 and the copy to this effect, marked as Annexure R-2-6 has been filed by the Respondents.
5. In view of the aforesaid background, I am not inclined to initiate the contempt proceedings, as claimed by the Petitioner herein.
The petition is accordingly dismissed.
No order as to cost(s).
